title: Derren Brown - The System (Full)
summary: Derren Brown's TV special in which he convinces a person he has a system for predicting horse race winners, demonstrating how survivorship bias and selective outcomes can fake predictive powers.
why: HN cites it as the classic demonstration of survivorship and confirmation bias in betting, trading and prediction claims.

quote.text: Here's an entertaining video from Derren Brown that shows how to use this technique to convince people you have psychic powers
